intended_object: A morphism θ : A → B of presheaves of commutative rings, viewed as a morphism of the underlying presheaves of (not necessarily commutative) rings, i.e. θ whiskered by the forgetful functor CommRingCat ⥤ RingCat. This is what the docstring "Forget commutativity of a whole map of ring presheaves" describes.
explanation: The body is exactly `Functor.whiskerRight theta (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)`. Its type, `ringPresheaf A ⟶ ringPresheaf B`, is correct, since `ringPresheaf R := R ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat`. Mathematically this is the identity: θ is the same family of ring maps, only retyped. It exists because Mathlib's `ModuleCat.extendScalars` and `restrictScalars` and its presheaf-of-modules API are stated over `RingCat`, so the library needs this map when it uses them later in the file (`tensorSection`, `tensorUnitSection`). It is a type-level change from commutative to general rings, an implementation detail of Lean's algebraic hierarchy, not a separate mathematical notion. It is correct for what it is meant to do.
